meta.description: Finance leadership in Barcelona: cash flow, France-Spain reporting, funding and coordination with your gestoría. Agree scope and budget together.

barcelone.h1: Fractional CFO in Barcelona for SMEs and startups
intro: Your business is based in Barcelona or operates between France and Spain. You need comparable figures, cash forecasts and a finance contact to prepare management decisions.

Barcelona is the registered office of Iter Advisors, at Carrer Casp 54. Benjamin Ziza, Florent Greth, Tom Jauffre and Deisy Arias Ramírez work there on finance matters. Working languages, on-site arrangements and contacts are specified during scoping.

sections.heading: Finance leadership for your business in Spain
content: An engagement can include a cash forecast, a budget and monthly reporting for management or investors. For a group operating in both countries, we define categories, assumptions and schedules so its entities can be compared consistently.

Funding preparation involves management and its advisers: financial model, scenarios, data room and follow-up questions. The SolarMente case describes financial structuring and transaction support; its results are not a forecast for another company.

links.label: Read the scope of the SolarMente engagement

sections.heading: Coordinate the CFO, your gestoría and advisers
content: Iter Advisors is not an accounting firm. Finance leadership organises performance management and coordination with your gestoría or Spanish accounting firm. Bookkeeping, returns, payroll and specialist advice remain assigned to the competent providers in the contract.

For a Spanish subsidiary, identify who produces local data, checks intercompany flows and reconciles them with group reporting. Tax and employment rules depend on your circumstances; no rate or benefit should be applied without assessment by the relevant advisers.
Hiring must also be reflected in forecasts: pay, employment costs, start date and onboarding capacity. A general salary difference between two cities cannot establish the cost of your role.

links.label: Organise finance management for a Spanish subsidiary

sections.heading: Funding: start with official programmes
content: ENISA offers participative loans for startups and SMEs. ACCIÓ publishes grant calls and business services. Barcelona Activa provides entrepreneurship support. These programmes have different purposes, schedules and conditions.

Consult current conditions and check the company's eligibility before preparing an application. The cash plan must distinguish application, decision and receipt of funds. Requested funding is not secured; budgets, supporting documents and responsibilities must be agreed with the parties involved.

sections.heading: Prepare your first discussion
content: Describe your entities, countries, tools, banks and existing contacts. Add the decisions to prepare and upcoming deadlines: hiring, closing, financing needs or investor reporting.

The first tasks involve reviewing available data, access and unreconciled items. Assign a person responsible for transmission and validation in each entity. The engagement's cadence depends on these needs, rather than just the registered address.

links.label: Agree the cadence of a part-time CFO

sections.heading: What budget should you plan in Barcelona?
content: __OFFER__

The quote specifies deliverables, contacts, availability and any travel. Iter applies the same pricing table across its locations; location alone does not establish a saving. One-off projects and adviser services must be distinguished from recurring support.

links.label: Compare Iter Advisors packages and fees

faq.question: How much does a Fractional CFO cost in Barcelona?
What languages and on-site arrangements are available?
faq.answer: Working languages, on-site visits, remote work and contacts are specified during scoping, according to needs and the professionals involved.

faq.question: Can you handle Spanish accounting?
faq.answer: Iter is not an accounting firm. We organise finance management and coordination with your gestoría or Spanish accounting firm. Preparation of accounts, returns and payroll is explicitly assigned to the relevant professionals.

faq.question: Can you guarantee a grant or financing?
faq.answer: No. Programmes depend on criteria, schedules and a decision by the organisation. Preparing an application and financial forecasts guarantees neither eligibility nor funding.

meta.title: Fractional CFO in Toulouse: scope and fees | Iter Advisors
meta.description: Fractional CFO for SMEs and startups in Toulouse. Cash flow, reporting and funding, with a quote based on scope. Remote support or on-site work by agreement.

toulouse.h1: Fractional CFO in Toulouse for your SME or startup
intro: Is your company in Toulouse looking for visibility over cash, margins or financing? A senior CFO manages finance alongside your teams and accountant, within a scope agreed before starting.

Engagements are managed from Paris and Barcelona, with travel to Toulouse agreed during scoping. The budget is EUR 3,000–8,000 excluding VAT per month; work starts 8 to 15 days after the first discussion, depending on the profile and scope.

sections.heading: What we define before starting
content: A dedicated finance contact, management's priorities, available data and the respective responsibilities of the CFO, your team and accountant.

Review schedules, deliverables and travel are agreed in writing. Routine discussions take place remotely; on-site meetings are organised according to the engagement's needs. We do not promise weekly local presence.

sections.heading: Three common needs to scope together
content: Service or manufacturing SME: track margins by activity or project, forecast receipts, manage working capital and prepare an investment with your banks.
Growing startup: establish reliable runway, build the budget and investor reporting, then prepare the financial model and data room if a funding round is planned.
Business expanding into Spain: coordinate entity reporting and finance, accounting and legal contacts from our Barcelona base.

sections.heading: First-month deliverables
content: A 13-week cash forecast, initial monthly P&L, cash and KPI reporting, and a finance review with management form the core of the Essential package.
The business plan, financing, consolidation or acquisitions extend the scope according to the package. Priorities are ordered according to your data and actual deadlines.

sections.heading: A budget based on the work entrusted
content: The national pricing table applies in Toulouse: Essential EUR 3,000–5,000 excluding VAT/month, Growth EUR 5,000–6,500, Premium EUR 6,500–8,000. Indicative involvement ranges from 1 to 8 days per month according to the package.

The retainer covers a scope and profile, not a number of days. Any travel costs are specified separately in the quote. No additional scope is billed without a signed amendment. No minimum engagement duration; cancellation requires 30 days' notice.

sections.heading: Our presence in Toulouse, in practice
content: We have no resident consultant in Toulouse. Our Paris and Barcelona teams manage engagements; the proposed professional is presented before signing so you can assess their fit with your business.
Our domiciliation address is 32 boulevard d'Arcole, 31000 Toulouse. Meetings take place remotely or at your premises, as agreed together.

faq.question: How much does a Fractional CFO cost in Toulouse?
faq.answer: EUR 3,000–8,000 excluding VAT/month depending on scope and profile. National pricing applies. Any travel is quoted separately.

faq.question: Will the CFO work at our premises?
faq.answer: Yes, according to a cadence agreed during scoping. Routine support takes place remotely from Paris or Barcelona; travel notably covers starting the engagement and finance reviews. No consultant is resident in Toulouse.

faq.question: Does the company need to have raised funding?
faq.answer: No. An SME without investors may need a cash forecast, margin tracking or a bank financing file. The scope follows these needs, not the way the company is financed.

faq.question: Do you have a Toulouse client case to share?
faq.answer: We do not yet have a publishable Toulouse client case. The studies on the site illustrate engagements carried out elsewhere. The proposed professional’s experience and expected deliverables are assessed during scoping.

faq.question: How soon can work start?
faq.answer: Allow 8 to 15 days from the first discussion, depending on the profile and complexity. Initial reporting deliverables arrive in the first month of the engagement.
